info.title: Intercom
info.description: Intercom is a customer communications platform combining help desk, AI chatbot, and engagement tools. Manage conversations, contacts, and tickets to power support workflows.

post.description: Search for conversations using filters such as state, creation date, assignee, or tags.

field.description: Field to filter on: created_at, updated_at, state, admin_assignee_id, team_assignee_id, tag_id.

value.description: Value to match. Use UNIX timestamp for date fields; string for state (open, closed, snoozed).

starting_after.description: Cursor from a previous response for the next page.

get.description: Retrieve a single conversation by ID, including its full message history.

post.description: Send a reply to an existing conversation as an admin.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The conversation ID to reply to.

message_type.description: The message type. Always 'comment' for replies.

admin_id.description: The ID of the admin sending the reply. Use List Admins to find admin IDs.

post.description: Search for contacts (users and leads) using filters such as email, name, or creation date.

field.description: Field to filter on: email, name, phone, role, external_id, created_at, updated_at, last_seen_at, signed_up_at.

operator.description: Comparison operator: =, !=, >, <, ~, IN, NIN, contains, starts_with.

value.description: Value to match against the specified field.

starting_after.description: Cursor from a previous response for the next page.

get.description: Retrieve a single contact by ID, including all profile data and custom attributes.

post.description: Create a new contact (user or lead) in Intercom.

email.description: Email address. Required for users; recommended for leads.

external_id.description: Unique identifier from your external system.

signed_up_at.description: UNIX timestamp of when the contact signed up in your system.

post.description: Search for tickets using filters such as state, creation date, or ticket type.

field.description: Field to filter on: created_at, updated_at, ticket_type_id, ticket_state.

value.description: Value to match. For ticket_state: submitted, in_progress, waiting_on_customer, resolved.

starting_after.description: Cursor from a previous response for the next page.

get.description: Retrieve a single ticket by ID, including its type, state, and custom attributes.

put.description: Update a ticket's state, assignment, or custom attributes.

state.description: New state: submitted, in_progress, waiting_on_customer, resolved.

admin_id.description: Admin ID to assign the ticket to.

team_id.description: Team ID to assign the ticket to.

open.description: Whether the ticket is open for new replies.

post.description: Create a new ticket in Intercom linked to an existing contact.

ticket_type_id.description: ID of the ticket type. Find this in Intercom Settings > Tickets > Ticket types.

contacts.description: Contacts to associate with the ticket.

post.description: Close an open conversation as an admin, with an optional closing comment.

message_type.description: The message type. Always 'close' for closing.

get.description: Retrieve all tags defined in the Intercom workspace.
Retrieve all admins and teammates in the Intercom workspace.

last_admin_reply_at.description: UNIX timestamp of last admin reply.

count_reopens.description: Number of times the conversation was reopened.

state.description: Conversation state: open, closed, or snoozed.

waiting_since.description: UNIX timestamp since waiting for reply.

part_type.description: Part type: comment, assignment, close, open, note, etc.

state.description: Conversation state: open, closed, or snoozed.

waiting_since.description: UNIX timestamp since waiting for reply.

name.description: Ticket type name (e.g., Bug Report, Feature Request).

ticket_state.description: State: submitted, in_progress, waiting_on_customer, or resolved.

ticket_attributes.description: Custom attributes defined on the ticket type.

away_mode_reassign.description: Whether conversations are reassigned while away.

has_inbox_seat.description: Whether admin has an inbox seat.
